title: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
1. Short title
and extent.‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the West Pakistan Tolls
on Roads and Bridges Ordinance, 1962.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Province of West
Pakistan, except the Special Areas.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
2. Definitions.‑In
this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires, the following
expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them, that
Is to say :‑
(a) "Government" means the Government of West Pakistan.
(b) "toll" means a charge levied under this
Ordinance for the use of a road or bridge.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Government may levy tolls

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
3. Government
may levy tolls.‑Government may cause tolls to be levied on all
persons, animals, vehicles or other things using, crossing or passing over any
road or bridge vesting in it or which may hereafter vest in it at such rates as
it may notify in the Official Gazette;
Provided that Government may declare any person or
any class or classes of persons, animals, vehicles or other things to be exempt
from the payment of such tolls.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Power to Government to set up toll-gates and stations

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
4. Power to Government
to set up toll‑gates and stations.‑When the rates of tolls to
be levied upon any bridge or road have been notified, Government may set up or
cause to be set up at or near such bridge or road, toll‑gates or stations
for the collection of tolls.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Table of tolls to be affixed to or near toll-gates etc

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
5. Table of tolls to be affixed to or near toll‑gates, etc.‑A table of the
tolls authorised to be taken at any toll‑gate or station set up under
section 4, legibly written or printed, shall be affixed to some conspicuous
place in or near such toll‑gate or station.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Collection of tolls

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
6. Collection
of tolls.‑Government may place the collection of tolls leviable under
this Ordinance under the management of such person as may appear to it proper.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Tools may be leased

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
7. Tolls may be leased.‑(1) Government may,
from time to time, lease out the tolls of bridge or road, by public auction or
private contract for any period not exceeding five years, on such terms and
conditions, as Government may consider desirable.
(2) When the tolls are put up
to auction, the Officer conducting the auction may, for reasons to be recorded
in writing, refuse to accept the offer of the highest bidder, and may accept
any other bid, or may withdraw the tolls from the auction.
(3) The acceptance of any bid
at an auction conducted under the provisions of subsection (2) by the officer
conducting the auction shall be subject to confirmation by Government.
(4) All arrears due from the
lessee on account of the lease of the tolls may be recovered from him or from
his surety, if any, as if they were arrears of land‑revenue.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Power to Government to cancel a lease

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
8. Power to Government to cancel a lease.‑(1)
Government may cancel the lease of the tolls on any bridge or road on the
expiration of three months' notice in writing to the lessee of its intention to
do so.
(2) When any lease is cancelled
under subsection (1), Government shall pay to the lessee such compensation for
the unexpired period of the lease as the Collector may award.
(3) Any party dissatisfied with
the award of the Collector given under subsection (2) may, within thirty days
of the date of such award, appeal to the Commissioner, whose decision shall be
final.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Lessee may surrender lease

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
9. Lessee may surrender lease.‑The lessee of the tolls of any
bridge or road may surrender his lease on the expiration of one month's notice
in writing to Government of his intention to do so, on payment of such
compensation as Government may direct.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Tolls may be compounded

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
10. Tolls may be compounded.‑Any person
entrusted with the management of the collection of tolls under this Ordinance
may, for a period not exceeding one year, or where the tolls on any bridge or
road have been let under section 7, the lessee of such tolls may, for the
period of the lease or any shorter period, compound for the tolls payable for
passage over such bridge or road.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Liabilities of persons employed in the management of tolls

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
11. Liabilities of persons employed in the management of tolls.‑Every person employed in the
management of tolls levied under this Ordinance shall be subject to the same
responsibilities as would lie on him if employed in the collection of land‑revenue.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Lessee and his agents deemed to be persons appointed to collect tolls

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
12. Lessee and
his agents deemed to be persons
appointed to collect tolls.‑When
the tolls on any bridge or road have been duly leased under section 7, the
lessee, and every person employed by the lessee as his agent for collecting the
tolls, shall be deemed to be persons appointed to collect tolls under this
Ordinance, and shall exercise all powers and be subject to all responsibilities
attaching to persons appointed to collect tolls under this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Penalty for refusal to pay tolls etc

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
13. Penalty for
refusal to pay tolls, etc.‑Whoever‑
(a) while crossing or passing over any bridge or road
on which tolls are levied, refuses to pay the proper toll ; or
(b) with
intent to avoid payment of such toll, fraudulently or forcibly crosses such
bridge or passes over such road without paying the toll ; or
(c) obstructs any toll‑collector or lessee or
any of his assistants or agents in any way in the execution of their duty under
this Ordinance ;
shall be punished with fine which may extend to two
hundred rupees.
sections.punishment:
shall be punished with fine which may extend to two
hundred rupees.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Penalty for unlawful levy of tolls or doing unlawful acts under colour of the ordinance

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
14. Penalty for
unlawful levy of tolls or doing unlawful acts under colour of the
Ordinance. ‑Whoever‑
(i) not being appointed to collect tolls under this
Ordinance, levies or demands any toll on any public road or bridge ; or
(ii) unlawfully and extortionately demands or takes
any other or higher toll than the lawful toll ; or
(iii) under colour of this Ordinance, seizes or sells
any property, knowing such seizure or sale to be unlawful ; or
(iv) in any manner unlawfully extorts money or any
valuable thing from any person under colour of this Ordinance ;
shall be liable, on conviction before a Magistrate, to
Imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months, or to a fine not exceeding
five hundred rupees, or both.
sections.punishment:
shall be liable, on conviction before a Magistrate, to
Imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months, or to a fine not exceeding
five hundred rupees, or both.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Power to toll collector to seize vehicles animals etc for non-payment of tolls

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
15. Power to toll collector to seize vehicles, animals, etc., for
non‑payment of tolls.‑Without prejudice to any other penalty
that may be imposed under this Ordinance, in case of non‑payment of any
toll on demand, the officer appointed to collect the same may seize any of the
vehicles or animals on which it is chargeable, or any part of their burden of
sufficient value to defray the toll, and, if any toll, together with the cost
arising from such seizure, remains undischarged for twenty‑four hours,
the case shall be brought before the officer appointed to superintend the
collection of the tolls, who shall thereupon issue a notice that on the
afternoon of the next day, exclusive of Sunday and any closed holiday, he shall
sell such property by auction and at the time specified In such notice he may
sell the property seized for the discharge of the toll, and all expenses
occasioned by such non‑payment, seizure and sale;
Provided that If at any time before the sale has
actually begun the person whose property has been seized tenders the amount of
all expenses incurred, and double the toll payable by him, the property seized
shall forthwith be released.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Police officers to assist tool-collectors

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
16. Police officers to assist toll‑collectors.‑Every
police officer shall be bound to assist a toll‑collector, when required,
in the discharge of his duties under this Ordinance, and for that purpose shall
have the same powers as he possesses in the exercise of his ordinary police
duties.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Jurisdiction of Courts barred

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
17. Jurisdiction of Courts barred.‑No proceeding shall lie in any Court in respect of
the amount of compensation payable under section 8 or 9 or the abatement of any
rent or lease‑money payable under this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Power of Government to delegate its powers

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
18. Power of
Government to delegate its powers.‑Government may delegate any of its
powers and functions under this Ordinance to any local authority or officer
subordinate to it.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Power to make rules

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
19. Power to
make rules.‑Government may, after previous publication, make rules
for the purpose of carrying into effect the provisions of this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Tolls on Roads and Bridges Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Repeal and savings

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN TOLLS ON ROADS AND BRIDGES
ORDINANCE, 1962
20. Repeal and
savings.‑(1) The Tolls on Roads and Bridges Act, 1875, hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, is hereby repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of the said Act,
everything done, action taken, obligation, liability, penalty or punishment
incurred, inquiry or proceeding commenced, officer appointed or person
authorlsed, jurisdiction or power conferred, rule made, notification issued or
lease granted under the provisions of the said Act shall, If not inconsistent
with the provisions of this Ordinance, continue in force and be deemed to have
been respectively done, taken, incurred, commenced, appointed, authorlsed,
conferred, made, issued or granted under this Ordinance.
